observations: Photo 0: one used automatic transaxle (front wheel drive gearbox) with a blue painted torque converter fitted in the bell housing.
Aluminium casing with dirt and oil staining; a green wire and a sensor or connector visible on the left side; output shaft seal area visible.
Shot taken in a crowded parts yard with other gearboxes around it; a watermark reading '... SPARE PARTS' is across the image.
No identification tag, casting code, part number or VIN plate is readable in the photo.
Only one angle; no view of the electrical connector, valve body, pan, mounting points or the other side of the case.
Nothing in the photo shows the vehicle it came from or that it runs.

identity.kind: used automatic gearbox (transaxle) with torque converter
read_from: photo 0 shape only: automatic transaxle with torque converter; no make or code readable

claims.evidence: No Toyota tag, transmission code or part number is readable in photo 0; the shape is consistent with a front wheel drive automatic transaxle but does not prove the make.
Origin cannot be shown by a photo of the casing.
The electrical connector is not clearly visible or countable in photo 0.
Fitment depends on the transmission code, which is not readable in photo 0.
Working condition cannot be seen in a still photo; no clip of it running or test record.
A sales opinion, not a fact about the item.

risks.risk: The gearbox is not the Camry unit claimed, or is a different code (4 speed vs 5 speed, 4 cylinder vs V6) that does not fit the buyer's car.
risks.proof: Close, sharp photo of the transmission identification tag or casting code on the case, plus the part number.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced as a Camry gearbox; identity stays unknown.

risks.risk: Internal failure: slipping, burnt clutches, bad solenoids or valve body.
risks.proof: Clip of the gearbox running in a car or on a test bench shifting through all gears, or a photo of clean fluid from the pan.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, for parts or rebuild.

risks.risk: Cracked casing, broken mounting ears or damaged connector on the sides not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides of the case including the connector and mounting points.

risks.risk: Torque converter and other parts may not be included or may be swapped from another unit.
risks.proof: Photo of the full unit as it will be handed over, with the converter and connector pins shown.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the bare unit seen.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the transmission identification tag or casting code and part number on the case.
Photo of the electrical connector showing the pin count.
Photos of every side of the gearbox, including mounting points and the pan.
Clip of the gearbox running and shifting in a car or on a bench.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transaxle, but no tag or code is readable, and the price of a gearbox is set by the exact vehicle and transmission code, which rests on the seller's words alone. The identification tag must be shown before even a worst case price is possible.
